column3: 5. The functions of the Institute shall be -

column4: to  assist  the  functions  of  a  technical  nature  of
the  National  Council  for  Disaster  Management
established under section 2 of the Sri Lanka Disaster
Management  Act,  No.  13  of  2005  as  the  national
focal point for landslide risk management;
to investigate, identify and map the areas prone to
landslides or the areas having geotechnical instability
and demarcate the susceptibility levels and prepare
hazard zonation maps;
to identify and declare an area with risk of a potential
landslide  as  a  “landslide  danger  zone”  for  the
purpose of evacuation of persons;
to  issue  early  warning  for  areas  with  potential
impacts due to landslides;
to  issue  Landslide  Risk  Assessment  Report  for
any  type  of  construction  or  development  activity
conducted in the area prone to landslides;
to  conduct  research  and  studies  on  landslides  and
monitor  impacts  of  climate  change  on  landslides
and to design and implement mitigatory measures
to reduce risks associated with landslide;
to provide proactive scientiﬁ c solutions to minimize
social, economic and environmental impacts due to
landslides;
